title: Expected Points push
description: What the home machine's ffp run pushes to KV: each priced player's Expected Points and per-Scoring-Stat means for an NFL Week's Games that haven't kicked off. Terms as in GLOSSARY.md.

sleeperId.description: Sleeper player id (the team for a D/ST). The home machine maps it from Sleeper's player list, which carries gsis and ESPN ids, so the Worker never downloads that list (14.7 MB).

gsisId.description: nflverse gsis_id; null for a D/ST.

espnId.description: From nflverse's id map; null if unmapped.

statMeans.description: Mean of each Scoring Stat for the whole Game, keyed as in ffp.scoring (kicker and D/ST keys settled in Sprint 11).

expected.description: Expected Points by Scoring Rules name.
